column1: Luis Arraez stands out as the top pick, hitting cleanup at home with a strong track record of consistency and a clear platoon advantage against Grant Holmes. Arraez has recorded a hit in nearly 75% of games and is swinging well lately, making him a reliable choice. Jackson Chourio also offers steady production from the leadoff spot with a favorable matchup. Bobby Witt Jr. and others trail slightly due to recent form or matchup uncertainty.
